title: Levin's flatworm experiments read as morphic resonance

tellings.quote: conventional explanation of Levin's experiments my explanation would be that it was morphic resonance with the previous form of the intact form of the flat worm they resonating with themselves in the past

related.note: This is the same flatworm memory experiment as #9, but it puts forward morphic resonance in place of the conventional explanation.

plain: A biologist known for unusual ideas, Rupert Sheldrake, speaking on podcast host Jesse Michels' show in 2024, offers his own explanation for flatworm experiments by Michael Levin, a biologist at Tufts University, in which worms seem to keep learned memories after losing their heads. Sheldrake says it is "morphic resonance", his idea that living things tune in to similar forms from the past, so the regrown worms are resonating with their own earlier, intact selves. If true, nature would carry a kind of memory outside the body.
